summary: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that displays current peak/off-peak status in a bottom-right badge, with a countdown to the next switch and expandable details when clicked.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily a user-facing interface add-on for DeepSeek Harness Web: it appears as a bottom-right overlay indicator that reports whether pricing is in peak or off-peak period and shows the next switch countdown, with a detail card on click. Its manifest and README show it is a web client plugin integrated through DSH’s patch/bundle mechanism rather than a code-generation or data-processing utility. Conservatively, the main risk is informational accuracy tied to time-window logic rather than privilege or external execution.
